declared_area_note: The prefectoral authorisation order of 31 May 2024 for DATA 4 SERVICES (capture georisques-data4-ap-autorisation-20240531.pdf, article 1.2.2) places the authorised installations on parcels B 66 and B 83 in Marcoussis and limits the order to installations operated by DATA 4 SERVICES; the cadastral API returns 913630000B0066 (24.4 ha) and 913630000B0083 (79.2 ha), which share a 1,445 m boundary and form one polygon of about 104 ha, close to the 110 ha Data4 gives for PAR01. The union also contains the separately registered III-V Lab building and areas registered to DATA 4 SAS, so the centroid locates the campus as a whole, not an individual data hall.
